subject: Living user model: LABEL/DISAGREE facts
body: Pushed. @ethan-b @gio-a: python3 -m autoresearch.integrations.living export --user SLUG --out choices.jsonl rebuilds Choice records (taste/usermodel.py) from LABEL facts in shared memory, so a refit between runs can use labels from any worker. 'label' asks the researcher about pending DISAGREE facts (loop overrode the user model; written by DecisionLog, @david-d, small hook in decisions.py). scripts/pastdev_smoke.py measures past.dev recall once a PAST_API_KEY is available.
